video_title: Pablo Torre unpacks latest findings on Kawhi Leonard's contract | Dan Patrick Show | NBA on NBC

quotes.speaker: Pablo Torre
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard's alleged secret sponsorship deal with Dactronics
quotes.excerpt: Kawhi Leonard had a secret, unannounced, multi-million dollar sponsorship for that company
quotes.quote: Two days after I published part one of my 13-part investigation, I got a tip saying that there is another secret sponsorship for Kawhi Leonard that was 1000% designed to circumvent the salary cap. I have spent the last 11 months trying to fact-check that, confirm it, and further report the story of why that would be. It turns out that yes, according to our reporting, we have two high-level sources. One who was under contract with the Clippers into a dome project, the other a former Clippers high-level source. They both say that the Jumbotron manufacturer Dactronics, which you may not know by name but you certainly know by sight, this one is the one that built the Halo Board. This is the $100 million project that Steve Ballmer built to create the greatest Jumbotron in human history. Kawhi Leonard had a secret, unannounced, multi-million dollar sponsorship for that company, which had never hired a celebrity spokesperson or sponsor before or since.

quotes.speaker: Pablo Torre
quotes.summary_phrase: Aspiration's financial struggles and Kawhi Leonard's undisclosed compensation
quotes.excerpt: That deal was $28 million under contract for a no-show endorsement deal that was never announced
quotes.quote: We are looking at 2023 and Aspiration is going bankrupt, it is under federal investigation by the end of that year. That deal was $28 million under contract for a no-show endorsement deal that was never announced. And also a $20 million equity deal in the company that was guaranteed to him. So that is $48 million in total value that was guaranteed to Kawhi Leonard on top of his NBA contract. Aspiration is struggling to make the payments in 2023, of course, and what happens next is the story of these last two episodes we have now done.

quotes.speaker: Pablo Torre
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard's decision to take less than the max contract
quotes.excerpt: Kawhi Leonard does something shocking to NBA media, certainly. He takes less than the max
quotes.quote: January 2024 comes around and Kawhi Leonard does something shocking to NBA media, certainly. He takes less than the max. A guy who truly is here to earn as much as he possibly can and beyond decides to take less from the Clippers to extend in January of 2024 while also still being owed money from this team sponsor Aspiration, which according to the bankruptcy filing we obtained, owes him at least $7 million.

quotes.speaker: Pablo Torre
quotes.summary_phrase: The Raptors' knowledge of Kawhi Leonard's 2019 contract issues
quotes.excerpt: The Raptors know the backstage of this with unusual clarity as that timeline 2019 is concerned
quotes.quote: Kawhi Leonard is traded from the Clippers to the Raptors, to the team by the way that originally alleged in 2019 that Kawhi Leonard and Dennis Robertson, his uncle, unlicensed agent, had requested benefits beyond the salary cap in violation of the CBA. These include no-show jobs, these include equity in the companies that they were hoping to get in business with through the team. So the Raptors know the backstage of this with unusual clarity as that timeline 2019 is concerned. They want to trade for Kawhi Leonard, but the trade is frozen.

quotes.speaker: Pablo Torre
quotes.summary_phrase: The NBA's indemnity of the Raptors and Clippers regarding Kawhi Leonard
quotes.excerpt: The NBA puts in front of the Raptors a piece of paper that effectively indemnifies the NBA
quotes.quote: The change is that the NBA puts in front of the Raptors a piece of paper that effectively indemnifies the NBA league itself and the Clippers from any legal resource or negotiation if there are punishments specific to Kawhi Leonard, because those punishments will travel with the player to Toronto. If you pay X, you are getting whatever Kawhi ends up being post-punishment. And the Raptors, in their perhaps eternal wisdom and this backdrop, say, then we are not signing this, and therefore the trade is not proceeding.

quotes.speaker: Pablo Torre
quotes.summary_phrase: Adam Silver's role in Steve Ballmer's Clippers tenure
quotes.excerpt: Adam Silver is not his mentor, David Stern. Adam Silver is actually the guy who welcomed Steve Ballmer
quotes.quote: Adam Silver is not his mentor, David Stern. Adam Silver is actually the guy who welcomed Steve Ballmer in in replacement of Donald Sterling and was hailed as this almost Aristotelian, brilliant, progressive leader in comparison to all the other commissioners, Roger Goodell namely, at that time. And now he is bookending perhaps his tenure with the same guy being an even bigger problem, a complicated problem. If you are Adam Silver and in 2019 when you cleared the Clippers and Steve Ballmer of cap circumvention after investigating the Raptors' claims and the Lakers' claims, what you have done by the way on the record is say salary cap circumvention is the cardinal rule of the NBA.
